subject: Media Literacy
title: Ethics Across Cultures
description: A quick win: understand Ethics Across Cultures.

hook.text: A Western outlet publishes a cartoon deemed blasphemous elsewhere. Free expression or cultural harm? It depends who you ask.

buildup.text: Western media ethics prioritize individual freedom and truth. Other traditions emphasize community harmony and respect.

discovery.text: There is no single global standard for media ethics. Cultural values shape what's considered responsible reporting.

twist.text: Global media reach means a story ethical in one culture can cause harm in another. Local standards clash with global audiences.

climax.text: Media ethics in a connected world requires understanding — not necessarily adopting — diverse ethical traditions.

punchline.text: Global reach demands global awareness. Your story crosses borders you never will.

quiz.question: Why do media ethics vary across cultures?
options: Cultural values shape what's considered responsible reporting
Ethics are universal and never vary
